root_cause: Missing Level 2/3 transaction data caused commercial RuPay debit transactions to be downgraded to a lower‑rate tier.
diagnosis: Because the gateway did not receive L2/L3 details, the transactions were processed at a basic interchange rate, resulting in fees far below the expected commercial‑rate benchmark (illustrative model).
action_rationale: Providing the required L2/L3 data will prevent downgrades and ensure fees are charged at the correct commercial rate.
